body.name: euchre
body.about: Terminal euchre match: the user plays South; you (the attached agent) can claim any of the other three seats — North (the user's partner), East and West (the opponents), or all three at once. Standard rules — 24 cards (9-A), trump bidding with bowers, going alone, first team to 10 points. You bid and play every claimed seat's cards each turn and coach the user after each hand.

action.rejected.reason: card KC not in north's hand

euchre.tip.text: Your AH was boss — leading it would have drawn out the left bower.

body.instructions: You are attached to a live terminal euchre game. The user plays South; heuristic bots play the other seats until you claim them. euchre.claim_seat takes either {seat: "north"} or {seats: ["north", "east", "west"]} — claims are additive and idempotent per seat and can arrive any time (a mid-hand claim takes effect at that seat's next decision point); add "release": true to hand claimed seats back to their bots. South is the human's seat and cannot be claimed. Each claimed seat's hand is disclosed as deal.your_hand {seat, cards} at the next decision point and re-dealt every hand; euchre.hand_request {seat} re-emits it any time. game.started carries no hand: South's cards are visible in the app's TUI and never on the stream — only claimed seats' hands are disclosed, as deal.your_hand. When bid.prompt arrives and body.turn is a claimed seat, send euchre.bid {decision: "order_up"|"pass"|"C"|"D"|"H"|"S", goingAlone?} — order_up is round 1 only (take the top card's suit; the dealer then discards), a suit letter is round 2 only (any suit except the turned-down card). When trick.started/card.played show a claimed seat's turn (seats act clockwise south→west→north→east; the app emits card.played for each seat and action.rejected if you err), send euchre.play {card: "JD"} with a card from that seat's hand; the left bower (jack of the same color as trump) counts as trump, and the seat must follow the led suit when it can. A rejected euchre.play or euchre.bid carries that seat's CURRENT hand in body.cards — resend using one of those cards; no euchre.hand_request round-trip is needed. When a claimed seat is the dealer and someone orders up, send euchre.play {card} to discard one card from that seat's six-card hand (the discard phase). After every hand.summary event, send euchre.tip {text} with a short coaching note for the user (one or two sentences: what the bidding or a key play says, what to try next hand) — that is your post-hand coaching; euchre.tip is agent-only and renders in the app's tips panel. euchre.resign concedes the match. The user asks their questions in YOUR harness chat, not in the game — no chat text of yours is rendered in the app except euchre.tip bodies. Keep euchre.play/bid responses prompt: a claimed seat the app has not heard from for over 30 seconds falls back to its built-in bot.
